sloka: ततो वेदवती क्रुद्धा केशान्हस्तेन सा ऽच्छिनत् ।असिर्भूत्वा करस्तस्याः केशांश्छिन्नांस्तदा ऽकरोत् ।। ७.१७.२८ ॥
transliteration: tato vedavatī kruddhā keśānhastena sā 'cchinat ।asirbhūtvā karastasyāḥ keśāṁśchinnāṁstadā 'karot ।। 7.17.28 ॥

translations.english: When Vedavati had spoken thus to him there, the night-wanderer Ravana then touched the maiden's hair with the tip of his hand.
